claim_label: Whether transparency and interpretability requirements will freeze AI innovation
description: The conflict centers on whether requiring data transparency and mechanistic interpretability will stall technological progress. One side views these demands as impossible standards that hinder life-saving innovation, while the other sees them as standard consumer protections that do not prevent advancement.

instances.assertion: Argues that demanding perfect transparency and interpretability sets an impossible standard that will stall life-saving technology.
Argues that transparency is a basic consumer protection standard already used in other industries, not a ban on innovation.
